setup_sentence_prediction_task: setup a sentence prediction task with classification or regression targets using SentencePredictionTask.setup_task
load_dictionary_for_prediction: load a token dictionary from a file and add a mask symbol using SentencePredictionTask.load_dictionary
load_dataset_for_prediction: load a train valid or test dataset split for sentence classification using SentencePredictionTask.load_dataset
build_classification_model: build a model with a registered classification head for sentence prediction using SentencePredictionTask.build_model
configure_sentence_prediction: configure sentence prediction with max positions, init tokens, and separator tokens using SentencePredictionConfig
